mechanism: Adapalene is a retinoid that increases skin photosensitivity and irritation risk, while estradiol may alter skin sensitivity and wound healing; concurrent use increases risk of cutaneous adverse effects and potential reduced contraceptive efficacy if adapalene affects estradiol absorption.
action: Monitor for increased skin irritation and photosensitivity; counsel on strict sun protection; consider timing of application to minimize irritation; verify contraceptive efficacy is maintained.
